signature: [no inscription; on garland, typical Ahlgren pattern of 3 repoussé crowns and 3 repoussé shocks of wheat]; Number “12” [later] on bell.
remarks: Two tubular slide stays, lower one telescopic; slide bow has ring and saddle; ferrules have Ahlgren’s star pattern; 1 tubular bell stay, flattening out on bellpipe side, with hinge, pin, and eye; bell bow has ring and saddle, saddle matches that in slide bow; Saxon-style rim wire; garland has tooth pattern—teeth are stamped; at top of garland below teeth is a band of engraved “diamonds”.
